description: Snow Telemetry (SNOTEL) Data Viewer is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by USDA Natural Resources Conservation Service, National Water and Climate Center. Resource managers and flood forecasters access SNOTEL (snow telemetry) data to monitor temperature, precipitation, and the amount of water stored as snowpack at remote mountain sites across the West. SNOTEL sites are automated weather stations installed in remote, mountainous areas where it’s difficult for people to travel. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Drought, Flooding – General, Severe Winter Weather. Assets: Agriculture and Food Supply, Forestry, Natural Areas and Wildlife, Water Infrastructure – General. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
